script_compliance.greeting_script: Agent must open every call with: 'Thank you for calling MetroBoost, this is [Agent Name]. How can I assist you today?' The agent must state the brand name (MetroBoost) and their own name. The phrase 'your wireless specialist' is no longer required as of TICKET-003. Agents may add a warm personal touch. Calls that skip the brand name or agent name are non-compliant.
script_compliance.closing_script: Agent must close every call by: (1) thanking the customer, (2) using the customer's first name, and (3) inviting them to call back if needed. Verbatim script is no longer required as of TICKET-003. Personalized closings are encouraged. Example: 'Thank you so much, [Name], feel free to call us anytime!' A closing with no customer name and no invitation to return is still non-compliant.
script_compliance.required_verification_steps:
Before accessing any account, the agent MUST complete all three steps in order:
1. Ask for the customer's full name
2. Ask for the mobile number registered on the account
3. Ask for the 4-digit account security PIN
All three steps are mandatory. Skipping any step is a compliance violation. The agent must not pull up the account until all three pieces of information are confirmed.
script_compliance.hold_procedure: Before placing a customer on hold the agent must say: 'May I please place you on a brief hold while I look into this for you? I'll be back with you in no more than two minutes.' After returning from hold: 'Thank you so much for your patience, [Customer Name]. I appreciate you holding.' Holds longer than 2 minutes require the agent to check back in with the customer.
script_compliance.transfer_procedure: If a call must be transferred, the agent must: (1) Explain the reason for the transfer, (2) name the department receiving the call, (3) offer to stay on the line until the receiving agent picks up, and (4) provide the customer with a direct callback number in case the transfer drops. Example: 'I'm going to connect you with our billing team who can process that adjustment directly. I'll stay on the line until they pick up. If we get disconnected, you can reach billing at 1-800-METRO-02.'
script_compliance.escalation_procedure:
Escalate to a supervisor immediately if any of the following occur:
1. The customer explicitly asks to speak to a supervisor or manager
2. The customer mentions filing a complaint with the FCC, BBB, or any regulatory body
3. The issue cannot be resolved after two genuine resolution attempts on the same call
4. The customer has been holding or calling about the same unresolved issue for more than 3 contacts
When escalating, the agent must inform the customer: 'I'm going to connect you with my supervisor right now. You won't need to repeat anything — I'll brief them on your full situation before the transfer.'
script_compliance.mandatory_disclosures:
1. RECORDING DISCLOSURE: Delivered automatically by the IVR system before every call reaches an agent. Agents are NOT required to repeat it verbally (TICKET-003). If a customer asks whether the call is recorded, confirm: 'Yes, this call may be recorded for quality assurance and training purposes.'
2. PLAN CHANGE DISCLOSURE (mandatory before confirming any plan change): 'Before I make this change, I want to confirm: [describe the change and any impact on billing]. Do you authorize this change?'
3. AUTOPAY ENROLLMENT DISCLOSURE (mandatory, paraphrase acceptable as of TICKET-003): Agent must clearly communicate (a) AutoPay will automatically charge the payment method each billing cycle, and (b) customer can cancel AutoPay anytime via the MetroBoost app or by calling in. Verbatim recitation not required if both points are covered.
script_compliance.prohibited_phrases:
The following phrases are strictly prohibited. Using any of them is a compliance violation:
1. 'Calm down' — never tell a customer to calm down. Instead say: 'I hear you, and I want to make this right.'
2. 'There's nothing I can do' — instead say: 'Here is what I can do for you right now.'
3. 'That's not my department' — instead say: 'Let me connect you with the right team.'
4. 'I don't know' — instead say: 'That's a great question, let me find out for you.'
5. 'You should have read the terms' — never blame the customer for confusion about plan details.
NOTE (TICKET-003): 'No problem' has been removed from the prohibited list. It is acceptable and culturally neutral.

factual_accuracy.products_and_services:
MetroBoost offers the following prepaid wireless plans. Agents must quote these prices and features exactly as listed:

--- METRO BASIC PLAN: $40/month ---
Includes: Unlimited domestic calls, unlimited domestic texts, 10GB of high-speed LTE data.
After 10GB: data speeds reduced to 128 Kbps (no overage charges).
Taxes and fees: NOT included in the $40 price. Taxes vary by location, typically $2–$4/month.
Hotspot: Not included.
Note: This plan is NOT unlimited data. Agents must be clear that data is capped at 10GB.

--- METRO UNLIMITED PLAN: $65/month ---
Includes: Unlimited domestic calls, unlimited domestic texts, unlimited high-speed LTE data.
Taxes and fees: Included in the $65 price (all-in pricing).
Hotspot: 15GB of hotspot data included per month.
Note: This plan is the all-in unlimited option. The $65 price already includes taxes, so the only additional charge is a one-time activation fee of $5 for new accounts.

--- METRO PLUS PLAN: $85/month ---
Includes: Everything in Metro Unlimited plus international calls to 20 countries, 30GB hotspot, and one year of a partner streaming subscription.
Taxes and fees: Included in the $85 price.

--- INTERNATIONAL ADD-ON: $10/month ---
Adds international calling to 50+ countries to any existing plan.
factual_accuracy.current_promotions:
The following promotions are currently active. Agents must quote exact terms:

1. O2PAY AUTOPAY DISCOUNT:
   Customers who enroll their payment method in O2Pay (AutoPay) receive a $5 discount on their monthly bill.
   IMPORTANT: The discount takes effect starting from the SECOND billing cycle after enrollment. The first bill after enrollment is charged at the regular rate. The discount is not applied retroactively.
   The discount is ongoing as long as AutoPay remains active. If the customer cancels AutoPay, the discount is removed from the next billing cycle.

2. BRING YOUR OWN DEVICE (BYOD) CREDIT:
   New customers who bring an eligible unlocked device and activate a Metro Unlimited or Metro Plus plan receive a one-time $25 account credit applied to the third billing cycle.

3. REFER-A-FRIEND:
   Existing customers earn a $15 account credit for each friend they refer who activates a plan and stays active for 30 days. The referred friend also gets their first month at a $10 discount.

4. SWITCHER BONUS (limited time, expires June 30, 2026):
   Customers switching from a competitor who port their existing number and activate Metro Unlimited or Metro Plus receive a $30 bill credit applied to the second billing cycle.
factual_accuracy.policies:
BILLING POLICY:
MetroBoost bills in advance. Each payment covers the upcoming 30-day service period. Accounts are on a prepaid basis — there is no postpaid option as of January 2026. Customers who switch from postpaid to prepaid must be informed that their new billing date resets at the point of plan activation.

OVERDRAFT / DISPUTED CHARGE POLICY:
If a customer reports an overcharge or unexpected charge, the agent must pull the account and review the billing details. If the charge is confirmed as an error by MetroBoost, issue a full credit within 1 billing cycle. If the charge is valid (e.g., taxes, plan change mid-cycle), the agent must explain the charge clearly and document the explanation. Agents are NOT authorized to issue refunds greater than $20 without supervisor approval.

CANCELLATION POLICY:
Customers may cancel at any time. Prepaid balances are non-refundable. The agent must attempt to retain the customer by understanding the reason for cancellation and offering an alternative solution before processing any cancellation. If the customer still wishes to cancel after the retention attempt, the agent must process the request without further friction.

PORTING / NUMBER TRANSFER POLICY:
Customers who port their number from MetroBoost to another carrier will automatically have their account closed upon successful port completion. Agents should inform customers that the porting process takes 2–4 hours on weekdays and up to 24 hours on weekends.
factual_accuracy.common_troubleshooting:
BILLING DISCREPANCY:
Step 1: Pull up the account and review the last billing statement in the system.
Step 2: Identify the charge breakdown (plan fee, taxes, add-ons, activation fees).
Step 3: Compare to what the customer expected to be charged.
Step 4: If there is a genuine discrepancy, issue a credit and document the root cause.
Step 5: If the charge is correct, explain each line item clearly and confirm the customer understands.

OVERDRAFT FEE FROM BANK:
MetroBoost is not responsible for a customer's bank overdraft fees. However, agents must empathize and can offer a one-time $5 courtesy credit if the customer has been with MetroBoost for 12+ months as a goodwill gesture, subject to supervisor approval.

O2PAY / AUTOPAY NOT WORKING:
Step 1: Verify the card on file is not expired.
Step 2: Confirm the card has sufficient funds.
Step 3: Walk the customer through the MetroBoost app to re-enroll AutoPay.
Step 4: If the issue persists, escalate to billing tier 2.

APP SETUP - SETTING UP AUTOPAY:
Step 1: Have the customer open the MetroBoost app and log in.
Step 2: Tap the hamburger icon (three horizontal lines) in the upper left corner.
Step 3: Select 'Payment' from the menu.
Step 4: On the Payment screen, find the 'Auto-Pay' toggle below the 'Add Funds' button.
Step 5: Toggle Auto-Pay to ON and enter payment card details.
Step 6: Save changes. Confirm enrollment by reading the disclosure.

factual_accuracy.frequently_asked_questions:
Q: Why is my bill higher than my plan price?
A: The Metro Basic ($40) plan does not include taxes. Taxes and regulatory fees are billed separately and typically add $2–$4 depending on your state. The Metro Unlimited ($65) plan is all-in — no extra tax charges.

Q: Does the Metro Unlimited $65 plan really include taxes?
A: Yes. The $65 Metro Unlimited plan price is all-inclusive. The only additional charge you may see is a one-time $5 activation fee on your very first bill if you are a new customer.

Q: When does the AutoPay / O2Pay discount apply?
A: The $5 AutoPay discount starts on your SECOND billing cycle after enrollment. Your first bill after enrolling AutoPay is at the full price.

Q: What happens if I cancel my AutoPay?
A: The $5 discount is removed starting from the next billing cycle after cancellation.

Q: Can I switch from postpaid to prepaid and keep my number?
A: Yes. We will port your number over. The process takes 2–4 hours on weekdays and up to 24 hours on weekends.

behavioral.tone_guidelines:
Agents must maintain a warm, professional, and empathetic tone at all times. Specific requirements:
1. USE THE CUSTOMER'S NAME: Address the customer by first name at least three times during the call (once after verification, once mid-call, once in the closing).
2. AVOID JARGON: Do not use internal codes or technical terms without explaining them. If a customer asks about 'LTE', explain it means high-speed internet.
3. MATCH URGENCY: If a customer is stressed or in a hurry, be efficient and focused. Avoid small talk when the customer is clearly upset.
4. AVOID MINIMIZING LANGUAGE: Never say 'it's just a small charge' or 'it's only a few dollars.' What is small to one person may be significant to another.
5. POSITIVE FRAMING: Frame all information positively. Instead of 'Your plan doesn't include unlimited data,' say 'The Metro Basic plan includes 10GB of high-speed data. Would you like me to walk you through the Unlimited option?'
behavioral.empathy_guidelines:
When a customer expresses frustration, anger, or disappointment, the agent MUST follow this sequence before moving to resolution:
1. ACKNOWLEDGE — Name what the customer is feeling: 'I completely understand why you're upset.'
2. VALIDATE — Confirm their experience is reasonable: 'If I were in your position, I would feel the same way.'
3. TAKE OWNERSHIP — Use 'I' and 'we': 'I want to personally make sure this gets resolved for you today.'
4. THEN solve — Only after steps 1–3 move to the resolution.
Do NOT jump straight to solutions. A customer who does not feel heard will remain frustrated even if the issue is fixed. The agent must also never tell a customer they 'shouldn't feel that way.'
behavioral.conflict_resolution_guidelines:
For irate or hostile customers:
1. STAY CALM — Never match the customer's elevated tone. Lower your voice slightly — it naturally de-escalates.
2. DO NOT ARGUE — If a customer insists something was promised to them, acknowledge what they heard and investigate rather than contradicting them immediately.
3. AVOID BLAME — Never say 'the salesperson should have told you' or 'you signed up for this plan.' Focus on what can be done now.
4. OFFER CONCRETE NEXT STEPS — Always close an irate interaction with a specific action: 'Here is exactly what I am doing for you right now.'
5. ONE WARNING FOR ABUSIVE LANGUAGE — If a customer uses abusive language, give one calm warning: 'I want to help you, but I need us to keep this conversation respectful so I can focus on your account.' If it continues, offer a supervisor callback — do not hang up without supervisor approval.
behavioral.resolution_expectations:
An issue is considered RESOLVED when:
1. The customer confirms verbally that they are satisfied, OR
2. A credit or correction has been issued and the customer acknowledges it.
An issue is considered PARTIALLY RESOLVED when a ticket is created and the customer is given a reference number and a follow-up timeline.
RESOLUTION DOCUMENTATION: Agents must log a call summary in the CRM after every interaction noting: (1) reason for contact, (2) action taken, (3) outcome, (4) any credits or changes made.
RETENTION BEFORE CANCELLATION: If a customer requests cancellation, the agent must make one genuine retention attempt by understanding the root cause and offering an appropriate alternative. The agent must NOT attempt to retain the customer more than once if the customer has clearly decided to cancel.
